query: SELECT symbol,date,open,high,low,close,consecutive_limit_ups FROM read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily_enriched/date=*/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=true) WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-23' AND symbol IN ('000810.SZ','002687.SZ','600785.SH','002354.SZ') ORDER BY symbol,date
rule: consecutive_limit_ups == 1; platform candidates, not certified historical identities
price_alignment: all four OHLC fields exactly equal to frozen chart inputs, all matching symbol/date rows
source_flag_version: read at export time; earlier flag snapshot not available
